8.5.5.2 EcuM_CheckValidation
[SWS_EcuM_02925] Definition of configurable interface EcuM_CheckValidation
Upstream requirements: SRS_ModeMgm_00003
⌈
Service Name
EcuM_CheckValidation
Syntax
void EcuM_CheckValidation (
EcuM_WakeupSourceType wakeupSource
)
Service ID [hex]
0x47
Sync/Async
Synchronous
Reentrancy
Non Reentrant
Parameters (in)
wakeupSource
–
Parameters (inout)
None
Parameters (out)
None
Return value
None
Description
This callout is called by the EcuM to validate a wakeup source. If a valid wakeup has been
detected, it shall be reported to EcuM via EcuM_ValidateWakeupEvent().
Available via
EcuM_Externals.h
⌋
The EcuM Manager module invokes EcuM_CheckValidation in the WakeupValidation
Sequence (see section 7.6.4 Activities in the WakeupValidation Sequence).
